# About this release:
This is a upcoming game by creator Miconisomi, not Illusion this time around.
I'm very fond of their games, but Miconisomi has been criminally overlooked in the past. 

I VERY much request that anyone able to do so buy the game upon release. 

I know I usually make similar requests for Illusion games, but that goes doubly so for this one. Games from Miconisomi feel like got heart put into them, there is a case that such a feeling is missing from the majority of Illusion games.

The game is not yet available for preorder, but I'll post the link here when it's available.

As for if I'll repack it when it releases... Not decided yet, but it looks very promising, so I just might...
